data.situation: At the small factory beside the river, green watering cans moved along two assembly lines. Workers fitted spouts and handles to the cans. Beyond the last workbench, finished cans waited for boxes. Mei picked up a carton from the floor. Its folded edge had cracked, and a strip of tape was holding it together. Three more damaged cartons lay beside it. She walked through the side door into the warehouse. The watering cans needed strong cartons, but the supply of cardboard was not unlimited. Arun showed her the remaining sheets on the bottom shelf. There were enough materials for the current order if fewer sheets were wasted. Buying more would take time; the order was due on Friday. At the table beneath the window, Mei unfolded one of the cracked cartons. The fold had wandered away from the pencil mark. She put a straight wooden edge beside a fresh sheet and folded the cardboard against it. The new carton closed neatly. Arun slipped one of the cans inside, lifted the carton by its base, and carried it back to the table. The fold stayed intact. Mei placed the wooden guide beside the damaged cartons. “We need to know the quantity we can pack with the cardboard we have,” she said. Arun wrote “one hundred cans” on a card and left it beside a clean stack of sheets. Tomorrow they would pack that number, record the cardboard used, and count any damaged cartons. They left the guide on the table, not on either assembly line.
data.easySummary: The factory makes watering cans on two assembly lines. Several cartons crack during packing. Mei checks the supply of cardboard in the warehouse and makes a better fold with a wooden guide. She and Arun will compare the materials used for the same quantity of cans.
data.easySummaryZh: 工厂的两条装配线制造浇水壶。装箱时几个纸箱开裂了。梅去仓库检查纸板存量，并用木制导向边折出更好的折边。她与阿伦准备比较装同样数量的壶所消耗的材料。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A visitor is looking for the cardboard, but has reached the room where the cans are made. Tell her which building to enter and what is stored there.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 来访者要找纸板，却到了制造水壶的房间。告诉她该去哪个建筑，以及那里放着什么。
acceptableAnswers: The cans are made in the factory. The cardboard materials are in the warehouse through the side door.

retrievalPrompts.cue: The delivery cannot arrive before Friday. Explain why Arun cannot simply keep throwing away cracked cartons.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 新货周五前到不了。解释阿伦为什么不能一直扔掉开裂的纸箱。
acceptableAnswers: The supply of cardboard is limited. We have enough materials only if we waste fewer sheets.

retrievalPrompts.function: The card on the clean stack
retrievalPrompts.cue: You will compare the cardboard used tomorrow with last week. Explain what quantity you will keep the same, and where the cans come from.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你们将比较明天和上周的纸板用量。说明要保持哪个数量相同，以及壶从哪里来。
acceptableAnswers: We will pack the same quantity: one hundred cans from the assembly lines.

transferPrompt.cue: A furniture factory has enough wood for twenty chairs, but several legs are damaged during cutting. New wood will arrive next week. Tell the team what to check before promising thirty chairs for Friday.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 家具厂的木材够做二十把椅子，但切割时几条椅腿损坏了。新木材下周才到。告诉团队，承诺周五交三十把椅子前应该核查什么。
acceptableAnswers: We should check the supply of wood and the quantity of chairs we can make with these materials. Thirty chairs may need more wood than we have.
